_comment: Original IELTS Writing vocabulary exercises for IELTS Vocabulary Master (CC BY-SA 4.0). Row: [category, prompt, options, answer_index, explanation_vi]. Categories: academic_word, formal, collocation, completion, paraphrase, task1_trend, task2_argument. Every item has exactly one correct option.
items: The government plans to ___ a new tax on sugary drinks.
'impose a tax' là collocation chuẩn, mang sắc thái học thuật: áp đặt một loại thuế.
Researchers ___ an experiment to test the new drug.
'conduct an experiment' = tiến hành thí nghiệm; trang trọng và chính xác hơn 'do'.
The results ___ that exercise improves memory.
'The results indicate that…' là cách diễn đạt học thuật chuẩn khi trình bày kết quả nghiên cứu.
A ___ number of students now study online.
'a large number of' là cụm chuẩn; 'big' ít trang trọng; 'much' không dùng với number.
The new policy had a ___ impact on unemployment.
'a significant impact' = tác động đáng kể – collocation học thuật.
Governments should ___ more resources to public health.
'allocate resources to' = phân bổ nguồn lực cho – chuẩn văn viết. 'spend on' sai cấu trúc với 'to'.
'exacerbate' = làm trầm trọng thêm; 'exaggerate' = phóng đại.
It is essential to ___ the root causes of crime.
'address the causes' = giải quyết các nguyên nhân; 'address' là ngoại động từ không cần giới từ.
Online learning has become increasingly ___ in recent years.
There is little ___ to support this claim.
'evidence' là danh từ không đếm được, không thêm -s.
The city has ___ a scheme to reduce plastic waste.
'implement a scheme' = triển khai một chương trình.
Many experts ___ that automation will replace routine jobs.
Tourism can ___ local economies by creating jobs.
'boost the economy' = thúc đẩy nền kinh tế; 'boast' = khoe khoang.
Lack of exercise is a major ___ of obesity.
'a major cause of' = nguyên nhân chính của; 'reason' đi với 'for'.
'carry out a survey' = thực hiện khảo sát.
These measures could ___ the effects of climate change.
'mitigate the effects' = giảm nhẹ tác động.
The report ___ several weaknesses in the system.
'highlight weaknesses' = nêu bật các điểm yếu.
Smartphones have ___ the way people communicate.
'transform' = thay đổi hoàn toàn; 'transmit' = truyền (tín hiệu).
Children from ___ backgrounds often lack access to good schools.
'disadvantaged backgrounds' = hoàn cảnh khó khăn/thiệt thòi.
Clean water is ___ for human survival.
Cần tính từ sau 'is': 'essential for' = thiết yếu cho.
Choose the more formal option: 'Lots of people think that…'
A considerable number of people believe that…
Trong Writing nên tránh 'lots of / loads of / reckon'; dùng 'a considerable number of… believe'.
Choose the more formal word for 'get rid of' (pollution).
'eliminate' = loại bỏ; trang trọng hơn 'get rid of'.
Choose the more formal word for 'find out'.
Choose the more formal word for 'go up' (prices).
'increase' là động từ trang trọng thay cho phrasal verb 'go up'.
Choose the more formal word for 'cut down on' (spending).
'reduce spending' trang trọng hơn 'cut down on spending'.
Choose the more formal word for 'put off' (a decision).
Choose the more formal word for 'look into' (a problem).
Choose the more formal word for 'need' in 'The project needs more funding'.
Choose the more formal word for 'get' in 'Students get qualifications'.
'obtain qualifications' = đạt được bằng cấp – trang trọng.
Choose the more formal word for 'help' in 'Technology can help learning'.
'facilitate learning' = tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho việc học.
Choose the more formal word for 'show' in 'The data show a rise'.
Choose the more formal word for 'enough'.
Choose the more formal option for 'kids'.
Trong Writing học thuật dùng 'children' thay vì 'kids'.
Choose the more formal option for 'a big problem'.
'a serious issue' phù hợp văn phong học thuật.
Choose the more formal word for 'start' (a programme).
'initiate a programme' = khởi xướng một chương trình.
Choose the more formal word for 'buy'.
Choose the more formal word for 'about' in 'about 50%'.
Choose the more formal word for 'deal with'.
'tackle a problem' = giải quyết vấn đề – trang trọng hơn 'deal with'.
Choose the more formal word for 'so' at the start of a sentence.
'Therefore' là từ nối học thuật thay cho 'So'.
Choose the more formal word for 'but' at the start of a sentence.
Trong văn viết học thuật, nên dùng 'However,' để mở câu.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a crime
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a decision
'make a decision' (Anh-Anh cũng dùng 'take a decision').
'do research' hoặc 'conduct research'; không nói 'make research'.
Choose the correct collocation: pose a ___
'pose a threat (to)' = gây ra mối đe dọa.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a role in
'play a role in' = đóng vai trò trong.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ attention to
Choose the correct collocation: ___ an effort
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a conclusion
'draw a conclusion' = rút ra kết luận.
Choose the correct collocation: a ___ lifestyle (little physical activity)
'a sedentary lifestyle' = lối sống ít vận động.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ the law
'break the law' = vi phạm pháp luật.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a deadline (finish on time)
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a living
Cả 'earn a living' và 'make a living' đều đúng (kiếm sống).
Choose the correct collocation: ___ responsibility for
'take responsibility for' = chịu trách nhiệm về.
Choose the correct collocation: a ___ argument (very convincing)
'a compelling argument' = lập luận thuyết phục.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a balance between work and life
'strike a balance between' = cân bằng giữa.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ the gap between rich and poor
'bridge the gap' = thu hẹp khoảng cách.
Choose the correct collocation: ___ a consensus
'reach a consensus' = đạt được sự đồng thuận.
Many young people move to cities ___ better job opportunities.
___ the high cost, many families still send their children abroad.
___ it is expensive, solar power is a long-term investment.
The number of tourists rose, ___ led to more pollution.
Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề trước dùng 'which'.
Children should be encouraged ___ more books.
Governments should prevent companies ___ toxic waste into rivers.
Students are responsible ___ their own learning.
This problem can be solved ___ raising public awareness.
There has been a growing interest ___ organic food.
Access ___ clean water is a basic human right.
The rise in obesity is largely ___ to poor diet.
The benefits of exercise far ___ the risks.
It is ___ that technology has changed our lives.
Sau 'It is' cần tính từ: undeniable.
___ speaking, city life is more stressful than rural life.
Not only ___ cycling healthy, but it is also cheap.
Đảo ngữ với 'Not only': Not only + trợ động từ + S.
The more people use public transport, ___ congestion there will be.
Cấu trúc 'the more…, the less…'; 'congestion' không đếm được nên dùng 'less'.
There are ___ cars on the roads than ten years ago.
Fewer people smoke now ___ in the past.
A large ___ of the budget was spent on education.
'a large proportion of' + danh từ không đếm được/tổng thể.
The ___ of students who passed increased.
'the number of + danh từ đếm được số nhiều'.
Which sentence has the closest meaning to: 'Many people are moving from the countryside to cities.'?
Rural areas are becoming more popular.
Việc di cư từ nông thôn ra thành thị chính là đô thị hóa (urbanisation).
Choose the best paraphrase of 'harmful to health'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'old people'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'people who live in a city'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'very important'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'getting worse'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'not having enough money'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'use too much'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'rich countries'.
'affluent nations' = các quốc gia giàu có.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'poor countries'.
'developing countries' thường dùng để chỉ các nước nghèo hơn, đang phát triển.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'many people believe'.
'It is widely believed that…' = nhiều người tin rằng.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'make something better'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'a problem that keeps getting bigger'.
'escalating' = leo thang, ngày càng nghiêm trọng.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'happening all over the world'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'cannot be avoided'.
Choose the best paraphrase of 'shortage of water'.
Sales went from 100 to 300 units. Sales ___.
The figure went from 80% to 40%. It ___.
Prices went up and down irregularly between $20 and $25. Prices ___.
The number reached its highest point of 500 in 2010. It ___ at 500.
Đạt mức cao nhất = peak at.
After rising for years, the figure stopped changing at 60%. It ___ at 60%.
Ngừng thay đổi sau giai đoạn tăng = level off.
The rate fell very quickly from 50% to 5%. It ___.
There was a sharp rise in sales.
There was a sharply rise in sales.
Danh từ đi với tính từ (a sharp rise); động từ đi với trạng từ (rose sharply).
'rise' là nội động từ: rise – rose – risen; không dùng bị động.
In 2000, 25% of energy came from coal. Coal ___ a quarter of energy production.
Choose the best word: 'There was a ___ increase from 40% to 41%.'
Tăng 1 điểm phần trăm là rất nhỏ → marginal/slight.
Choose the best word: 'Car use ___ dramatically, from 10% to 70%.'
Từ 10% lên 70% là tăng mạnh (increased dramatically).
The figures for 2030 are predictions. Which phrase fits?
Dữ liệu dự báo dùng 'is projected/expected to'.
Choose the correct option: 'The figures for Japan and Korea were 20% and 30% ___.'
Choose the best linking word: 'Spending on food fell, ___ spending on travel rose.'
'whereas' dùng để so sánh tương phản hai xu hướng.
Which sentence is the best overview?
Overall, renewable energy use increased while coal use declined.
Overview tóm tắt xu hướng chính, không nêu số liệu chi tiết.
In a map description: 'The trees were cut down to ___ a car park.'
In a process: 'The grapes ___ and then crushed.'
Mô tả quy trình dùng bị động: are harvested.
Choose the correct option: 'The number of visitors ___ from 2 million to 5 million.'
rise – rose – risen; 'raised' cần tân ngữ.
Unemployment fell from 10% to 8%. It fell by ___.
Chênh lệch giữa hai tỷ lệ phần trăm tính bằng 'percentage points'.
'Admittedly' dùng để thừa nhận ý kiến trái chiều trước khi phản bác.
Which phrase introduces an additional point?
Which sentence states an opinion clearly and formally?
I firmly believe that public transport should be free.
I think maybe transport is kind of good.
Câu nêu quan điểm rõ ràng, trang trọng.
Which phrase is best for hedging (being cautious)?
'It could be argued that' giúp diễn đạt thận trọng, khách quan.
Choose the best phrase for a problem–solution essay: 'One possible ___ is to raise fuel taxes.'
'One possible solution is to…' = một giải pháp khả thi là…
Choose the best phrase: 'The main ___ of this trend is the rising cost of living.'
Nói về nguyên nhân: 'The main cause of…'.
Choose the best phrase: 'This trend has several negative ___ for society.'
Which sentence best expresses partial agreement?
I agree with this view to some extent.
I agree completely and without exception.
'to some extent' = ở một mức độ nào đó (đồng ý một phần).
Discussion essay: 'Some people believe X. ___, others argue that Y.'
Bài discussion trình bày hai quan điểm đối lập: 'On the other hand'.
Choose the best phrase to refer to supporters of an idea.
Choose the word that means 'to make a problem worse'.
'aggravate' = làm trầm trọng thêm; ba từ còn lại đều có nghĩa làm nhẹ bớt.
Choose the word that means 'to make a problem less severe'.
Many young people spend a lot of time online.
All young people are addicted to the internet.
Tránh khái quát hóa tuyệt đối (all, every, nobody) trong Writing.
Two-part question: 'Why is this happening? Is it positive?' Which phrase begins the second part?
As for whether this is a positive development,
To conclude the first part again,
'As for…' chuyển sang phần câu hỏi thứ hai.
Choose the best topic sentence for a body paragraph about advantages.
The primary advantage of working from home is greater flexibility.
Topic sentence cần nêu rõ ý chính của đoạn.
